issues.legal_issue: An electricity distributor cannot deny an auction purchaser a fresh connection solely because the former owner left unpaid electricity arrears when the purchaser did not undertake to discharge those arrears.
material_facts: The purchaser acquired the property at an auction advertised on an “as is where is” basis.
The purchaser applied for a fresh domestic electricity connection to the acquired property.
The purchaser was unconnected to the former owner and had not undertaken to pay the former owner's electricity arrears.
The distributor refused to release the connection because the former owner’s electricity charges remained unpaid.
The High Court ordered that the connection not be withheld, and the distributor appealed.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was dismissed, and the distributor could not withhold the purchaser’s fresh electricity connection on account of the former owner’s arrears.
issues.legal_principle: An auction purchaser who seeks a fresh electricity connection is not liable for the previous owner’s electricity arrears, and the connection cannot be refused solely for non-payment of those arrears where the purchaser did not undertake to pay them. The Court applied Isha Marbles v. Bihar State Electricity Board, (1995) 2 SCC 648; Ahmedabad Electricity Co. Ltd. v. Gujarat Inns (P) Ltd., (2004) 3 SCC 587; and NESCO v. Raghunath Paper Mills (P) Ltd., (2012) 13 SCC 479. Although the auction arose under the SARFAESI Act, 2002, the judgment does not rely on a specific statutory provision as the basis for its ruling.

rule.if: appeal_challenges_denial_of_fresh_connection and auction_purchaser_seeks_fresh_connection and sale_notice_says_as_is_where_is and purchaser_unconnected_to_former_owner and purchaser_did_not_assume_former_owner_arrears

predicates.appeal_challenges_denial_of_fresh_connec: A party appeals a ruling that prevented it from denying a fresh electricity connection because of a former consumer’s arrears.
predicates.auction_purchaser_seeks_fresh_connection: A purchaser who acquired property at auction applies for a fresh electricity connection to that property.
predicates.sale_notice_says_as_is_where_is: The auction sale notice states that the property is sold on an “as is where is” basis.
predicates.purchaser_unconnected_to_former_owner: The auction purchaser has no connection to the former owner of the property.
predicates.purchaser_did_not_assume_former_owner_ar: The purchaser did not undertake to discharge the former owner’s electricity arrears.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns denial of a fresh connection sought by an auction purchaser who is unconnected to the former owner and did not assume the former owner’s arrears, and the sale notice was on an “as is where is” basis, the connection cannot be denied for those arrears.
